::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 29 1868  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55388 (1): P. 302
:::

Dear Miss Yonge,
[I](people/person_939.qmd) enclose the [monthly cheque](organizations/other_160.qmd) with best remembrances.

I hope the [Cameos](cmy_books/cmybook_73.qmd) will get out by & by. The volume proves thinner than I had expected and I am making calculations as to price. This first edition at 4/6 or even 5/- will not yield much. Are you disposed to sell us the copy right?

Yours very faithfully
A. Macmillan
